key_finding: AAOI's FY2025 result is the strongest in company history: $455.7M revenue (+82.8% YoY), GAAP gross margin 30.0% (up from 24.8%), net loss narrowed to $38.2M from $186.7M. The acceleration is driven by CATV recovery (53.8% of FY mix) AND datacenter ramp (42.9%), with Q4 2025 marking the first quarter datacenter revenue exceeded CATV. Accumulated deficit remains heavy at $493.1M — this is a company recently lifted out of an existential trough rather than a maturely profitable franchise. Customer concentration is severe: Digicomm 53.1% + Microsoft 28.8% = 81.9% of FY25 revenue.

digicomm.trajectory: Up sharply for second consecutive year — Digicomm tripled from ~11% of revenue in 2023 to 53% in 2025. It is the channel partner for the CATV ramp.

microsoft.trajectory: Declining as share but still the largest hyperscale datacenter customer — the absolute dollar value is rising as total revenue grew 83%

headcount_dec_31_2025.union_status: No US collective bargaining; some China subsidiary workers union members

manufacturing_footprint.us: Sugar Land, Texas — headquarters + US data center transceiver manufacturing (exit-2025 capacity ~100k units/month 800G, 35% from US)
manufacturing_footprint.china: Ningbo — laser device fabrication + transceiver assembly
manufacturing_footprint.vertical_integration: In-house laser fabrication using proprietary MBE (molecular beam epitaxy) and MOCVD processes

capital_allocation_priorities: Continue to invest in US production for data center products with automated processes
Continue to invest in new products, new technology, and highly-automated production infrastructure
Vertical integration: in-house laser fabrication, transceiver assembly, networking subsystems

amazon_warrant_march_2025.context: Part of broader hyperscale supply relationship — separate from the Microsoft and Digicomm revenue lines. Vesting tied to purchase volume thresholds.

balance_sheet_observations.accumulated_deficit: $493.1M (FY25 year-end) — concentrates the cyclical historical losses, mostly from the 2018-2023 trough years
balance_sheet_observations.interpretation: Company is now revenue-growing and margin-expanding but balance sheet still carries the scar tissue of pre-2024 cycles; positive operating leverage hasn't yet produced net profitability
